QF.id: SIA Logic Model for Social Programs_40

question.text: Per Ch 4.3.2, Internal KPIs play what role relative to External KPIs?

answer.text: Internal KPIs play a supportive role in feeding information to External KPIs
Internal KPIs are hidden from the SE's management
Internal KPIs are audited by the donor directly without SIA involvement

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 4.3.2, Internal KPIs play a supportive role in feeding information to External KPIs. External KPIs (the select pertinent KPIs used by outcome funders/risk investors) rely on upstream internal KPI data. The SIA should understand both sets and how one feeds the other when scoping assurance. The Trap: A inverts the relationship. C contradicts internal-monitoring purpose. D removes the SIA from the loop, which contradicts ICAI SIAB empanelment role. Cross-Exam Context: Tested in XXIII Ch 5 and Ch 7 (SAS scoping). Assessor's Pro-Tip: During scoping, walk the SE through the data flow: 'Which internal KPI feeds this external KPI?' Breaks in the feed chain are audit risks — the external number may lack upstream evidence.
